researcher_notes: KEY FINDING for this lane's uni-assist question: Universität Hamburg does NOT use uni-assist.de as a deadline-setting authority and does NOT require it. Hamburg runs its own free foreign-qualification recognition portal as the primary/default route — the qualification-recognition equivalent of what uni-assist does elsewhere, done in-house and free of charge. uni-assist e.V.'s preliminary review documentation (VPD) and evaluation results are accepted only as ALTERNATIVE evidence: e.g. for applicants who already hold a uni-assist evaluation from applying to another German university, and specifically as a fallback for applicants who missed Hamburg's normal application deadline but hold 'an evaluation report from uni-assist e.V., or an APS certificate, or 211 confirmation' (see FAQ page, https://www.uni-hamburg.de/en/campuscenter/bewerbung/international/studium-mit-abschluss/anerkennung-auslaendischer-schulbildung/20-faq.html). No uni-assist.de page was found stating an independent Hamburg-specific deadline; every dated application window found in this batch is stated on uni-hamburg.de pages themselves. This places Hamburg in the 'does not use uni-assist at all as a deadline authority' bucket — structurally similar to Bonn, which instead defers Medicine/Dentistry/Pharmacy deadlines to hochschulstart.de (see HAM0029/DL-HAM0008 below for Hamburg's own, separate hochschulstart.de deferral, which is a different external system for a different subset of programmes).

requirement_text: Two applicant groups exist with different admission procedures. Group 1 covers EU/EEA citizens, stateless persons, and applicants holding a German higher education entrance qualification, selected using grade-based NC (Numerus Clausus) values. Group 2 covers non-EU/non-EEA international applicants without a German qualification, selected via a bonus-points system in which the grade of the applicant's foreign higher education entrance qualification is translated into a point value, with additional bonus points available for language skills or academic preparation.

researcher_notes: Confirms Universität Hamburg does NOT state its own independent admission/application deadline for Medicine, Dentistry or Pharmacy: the selection process runs entirely through hochschulstart.de (Stiftung für Hochschulzulassung), and the enrollment deadline is communicated individually in each applicant's own admission letter (Zulassungsbescheid) rather than published centrally. Mirrors the precedent already recorded for Bonn (BON0011) in this same research batch.

program_name: Medicine / Dentistry / Pharmacy — Vocational Qualification quota
requirement_text: Study applicants with a university entrance qualification obtained through vocational qualification, who hold no other higher education entrance qualification, do not participate in the hochschulstart.de application and selection procedure for medical study programmes at Universität Hamburg, but must apply directly to the university through the Vocational Qualification quota, which accounts for only 0.2% of total study places.

requirement_text: § 38 HmbHG ermöglicht beruflich Qualifizierten ohne schulische Hochschulzugangsberechtigung den Hochschulzugang ohne Abitur an der Universität Hamburg über eine Eingangsprüfung. Zulassungsvoraussetzungen: eine abgeschlossene Berufsausbildung sowie eine sich daran anschließende mindestens dreijährige berufliche Tätigkeit in Vollzeit (Teilzeittätigkeiten werden anteilig anerkannt; Praktika und geringfügige Beschäftigung nicht; bis zu zwei Jahre Kindererziehung, Pflegetätigkeit, Freiwilligendienst oder Wehr-/Zivildienst sind anrechenbar; in begründeten Ausnahmefällen genügt eine zweijährige Berufstätigkeit für Stipendiaten bestimmter Förderprogramme).

researcher_notes: Eligibility gate for a named legal pathway (Hamburg's state higher education law, HmbHG §37/§38) into Bachelor's/Staatsexamen study WITHOUT the Abitur, for applicants with vocational (not academic) qualifications — distinct from every other requirement in this batch. §37 HmbHG (Meisterprüfung/Fortbildungsprüfung) grants entrance-qualification status outright with no exam; §38 HmbHG (this record) requires sitting the Eingangsprüfung. The Sozialökonomie B.A. programme runs its own separate procedure with different deadlines under this same vocational-access framework (noted but not independently researched in this batch).

requirement_text: Die Eingangsprüfung setzt sich aus insgesamt vier Prüfungsleistungen zusammen: Motivationsschreiben (drei bis fünf Seiten, mit dem Online-Antrag einzureichen); Erste Klausur (Thema aus dem öffentlichen Leben, drei Zeitstunden); Zweite Klausur (studiengangspezifisches Thema); Mündliche Prüfung (ca. 30 Minuten, in der Regel im Juni), zu der nur zugelassen wird, wer Motivationsschreiben und beide Klausuren bestanden hat. Die Bewertung orientiert sich am erwarteten Leistungsstand von Abiturientinnen und Abiturienten. Die Eingangsprüfung kann pro Studiengang einmal wiederholt werden. Das Zeugnis ist zeitlich unbegrenzt gültig.

requirement_text: Perhaps you would like to study at Universität Hamburg but your foreign higher education entry qualification (Abitur) doesn't qualify you to do so. Studienkolleg Hamburg offers year-long courses (language of instruction: German) to prepare for the Feststellungsprüfung, an assessment exam that demonstrates the language skills and subject-matter fulfillment needed to study at a German university. A passing assessment test is also recognized by Universität Hamburg as proof of sufficient German language skills.
